Sounds like it's probably unrelated, but I had a similar problem with my computer starting to freeze when I'd try to run training. I realized out that the temp files FakeApp creates weren't being automatically deleted for some reason and had mostly filled up my SSD even though it was being displayed as having tonnes of space left in windows explorer. Once I'd deleted them everything went back to normal.

Assuming you're using Windows, try this: Press the Win+R, type in '%temp%', press enter, then delete everything in the folder. It'd also be worth emptying your recycling bin while you're at it. Chances are it won't do anything, but it's worth a shot.
